title: Transfer of Anti-Sycophancy Training Across Domains

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: if anti-sycophancy training transfers across domains, practitioners can apply it efficiently. If not, comprehensive coverage is needed. The finding is informative but the actionability depends on the direction of the result.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires implementing anti-sycophancy training, which itself involves fine-tuning with specialized data. Then evaluating across four domains (factual QA, opinion, creative writing, medical). The training step is the bottleneck for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Single training run, then evaluation across four domains. The evaluation part is straightforward. The training part is the challenge. If the anti-sycophancy model is pre-built, this becomes a pure evaluation project and is well-scoped.
